professionalSummary.text: Owns quality for the ticket-routing service end-to-end and holds the go/no-go for each weekly release.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated release scope with the development lead and support operations in the weekly release meeting; the development lead set the scope and the release manager held the go/no-go for each weekly release.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the service's automated test suites and the release-gate checks in the pipeline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the ticket-routing service's automated test suites (unit, contract and load) and the release-gate checks in the pipeline, adding a routing-rule regression pack after two escaped defects in rule evaluation.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Analyses escaped defects and records root causes and prevention actions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Analysed escaped defects each fortnight, recording root causes and prevention actions in the quality log and presenting them at the engineering review.

skills.text: Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release.
skills.witness: Wrote the release quality notes for each release, listing known limitations (load tests did not cover the enterprise tier's rule volumes) and the hand-over items for support operations.
